import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

# Configuration
train_path = "./input/train.csv"
test_path = "./input/test.csv"
sample_path = "./input/sample_submission_null.csv"
sub_dir = "./submission"
os.makedirs(sub_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)
sample_df = pd.read_csv(sample_path)


# Text cleaning function: remove surrounding quotes and handle escapes
def clean_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    s = str(text).strip()
    while len(s) >= 2 and s[0] == '"' and s[-1] == '"':
        s = s[1:-1]
    s = s.replace('\\"', '"')
    return s


train_df["clean_text"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test_df["clean_text"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)

# Prepare features and labels
X_full = train_df["clean_text"].values
y_full = train_df["Insult"].values.astype(int)

# Stratified hold-out split for validation
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_full, y_full, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_full
)

# TF-IDF Vectorization
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=15000,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    sublinear_tf=True,
    min_df=2,
    stop_words="english",
    dtype=np.float32,
)
X_train_tfidf = tfidf.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_tfidf = tfidf.transform(X_val)
X_test_tfidf = tfidf.transform(test_df["clean_text"].values)

# Train Logistic Regression with balanced class weights
model = LogisticRegression(
    C=1.0, max_iter=1000, class_weight="balanced", random_state=42, solver="lbfgs"
)
model.fit(X_train_tfidf, y_train)

# Evaluate on hold-out validation set
val_probs = model.predict_proba(X_val_tfidf)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_probs)
print(f"Hold-out Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.4f}")

# Generate predictions for the test set
test_probs = model.predict_proba(X_test_tfidf)[:, 1]

# Prepare and save submission file
submission = sample_df.copy()
submission.iloc[:, 0] = test_probs
output_path = os.path.join(sub_dir, "submission.csv")
submission.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {output_path}")
